bio: This inviting restaurant is located directly on the market square next to the small church. The two inviting dining rooms are done out in white with light wood furnishings and lovely cross-vaulted ceilings. There are also a few tables on the terrace in front of the building. The menu features flavoursome home-style regional fare such as braised rabbit leg with red cabbage and dumplings. Attentive service. The reasonably priced lunch deals are especially popular – reservations are recommended. In the evening, the cuisine is a little more upscale. Tip: Factor in enough time for a stroll through the pretty old town....
